explanationEn: To meet its target, a center's actual collection must be at least as large as its own target. The Sunset Mall reached 220 tons against a target of 190 tons, so it met the target. In each of the other choices the actual figure is below that center's own target, even where it is larger than the winning figure (220), because the targets differ.
answerRationale: Sunset Mall만 실제(220)가 목표(190) 이상이다.

passage: A literacy researcher tested students' reading speed in several classrooms at the start and at the end of a semester-long reading program. The graph below shows the results. The literacy researcher claims that the average reading speed of at least one of the classrooms rose by more than 35 words per minute.
question: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to support the claim?
options: Room Dune's average reading speed went from 210 words per minute at the start of the semester to 230 words per minute at the end of the semester.
Room Fjord's average reading speed went from 115 words per minute at the start of the semester to 165 words per minute at the end of the semester.
Room Ember's average reading speed went from 100 words per minute at the start of the semester to 120 words per minute at the end of the semester.
Room Basil's average reading speed went from 180 words per minute at the start of the semester to 205 words per minute at the end of the semester.

figure.title: Average Reading Speed at Start and End of Semester

explanation: 주장은 증가량이 35 words per minute보다 커야 한다고 요구한다. Room Fjord은(는) 115에서 165 words per minute로 50 words per minute 증가해 기준을 넘는다. 나머지 선택지의 증가량은 최대 30 words per minute로 기준에 못 미친다(Room Dune은 at the end of the semester의 값이 가장 크지만 증가량은 충분하지 않다).
explanationEn: The claim requires an increase of more than 35 words per minute. Room Fjord rose from 115 to 165 words per minute, an increase of 50 words per minute, which exceeds 35. The other choices describe increases of at most 30 words per minute, including Room Dune, which has the highest value at the end of the semester but not a large enough increase.
answerRationale: Room Fjord의 증가량 50만 기준 35를 넘는다.

passage: A glaciologist measured the thickness of ice at a fixed survey point on a glacier at the end of each summer. The graph below shows the results. The glaciologist claims that in a single year, the ice thickness rose by more than 30 meters.
question: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to support the claim?
options: From 2013 to 2015, ice thickness went from 150 meters to 230 meters.
From 2015 to 2016, ice thickness went from 230 meters to 250 meters.
From 2014 to 2015, ice thickness went from 175 meters to 230 meters.
From 2011 to 2012, ice thickness went from 130 meters to 145 meters.

figure.title: Ice Thickness at the Survey Point

explanation: 주장은 한 해 사이에 30 meters보다 크게 올랐다는 것이다. 2014년에서 2015년 사이 값은 175에서 230 meters로 55 meters 올라 기준을 넘는다. 2013년~2015년 선택지는 두 해에 걸친 변화(80 meters)라 한 해의 상승을 보이지 못하고, 나머지는 한 해 변화가 최대 20 meters에 그친다.
explanationEn: The claim is about a rise of more than 30 meters within a single year. From 2014 to 2015, the value rose from 175 to 230 meters, an increase of 55 meters, which exceeds 30. The choice covering 2013 to 2015 spans two years, so its larger change (80 meters) does not show a one-year rise; the remaining choices show one-year changes of at most 20 meters.
answerRationale: 2014→2015 상승 55만 기준 30를 넘는다(두 해 구간은 함정).

passage: A food scientist baked loaves with different flour blends and measured how much each loaf's volume rose during proofing. The table below shows the results. The food scientist claims that the millet blend had a greater proofing rise than the whole wheat blend.
question: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the claim?
options: The millet blend had a proofing rise of 72%, while the oat blend had a proofing rise of 37%.
The whole wheat blend had a proofing rise of 53%, while the buckwheat blend had a proofing rise of 43%.
The spelt blend had a proofing rise of 50%, while the oat blend had a proofing rise of 37%.
The whole wheat blend had a proofing rise of 53%, while the millet blend had a proofing rise of 72%.

figure.title: Dough Volume Increase by Flour Blend

explanation: 주장은 the millet blend와 the whole wheat blend를 비교하므로, 정답은 두 대상의 값을 모두 제시해야 한다. 자료에서 millet blend는 72%, whole wheat blend는 53%로 차이가 19%이므로 주장을 뒷받침한다. 나머지 선택지는 값은 맞지만 비교 대상 중 하나 또는 둘 다를 빠뜨려 이 주장을 뒷받침하지 못한다.
explanationEn: The claim compares the millet blend with the whole wheat blend, so the correct choice must give the value for each of those two items. The millet blend had a proofing rise of 72% and the whole wheat blend had 53%, a difference of 19%, which supports the claim. Each of the other choices reports accurate values but leaves out the millet blend, the whole wheat blend, or both, so none of them can support a claim about that comparison.
answerRationale: millet blend(72)와 whole wheat blend(53)의 두 값을 모두 인용한 선택지만 비교 주장을 뒷받침한다.
